walk_meta.subtitle: Kazimierz — Kraków's Jewish District · Guide: Jacob, Walkative Tours
walk_meta.excerpt: Jacob leads a walk through nine centuries of Jewish life in Kraków — from the Remu Synagogue to the Hasidic legend of Lilith, from Helena Rubinstein's birthplace to the chairs memorial on Ghetto Heroes Square — covering everything Schindler's List got right, and what it simplified.
